name: ListEventStreamings

parameters.help_en: The name prefix of the event stream
parameters.name: name_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries returned per request. You can use this parameter together with NextToken to implement paging.
<notice>The maximum number of entries returned per request cannot exceed 100.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
限定每次返回的最大条数，可以和NextToken搭配使用实现翻页能力。
<notice>每次返回的最大条数不超过100。></notice>
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: If the number of entries exceeds the value of Limit, a NextToken is returned
parameters.help_zh: 当指定Limit时，如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ARN of the event source
parameters.name: source_arn

parameters.help_en: The ARN of the event target
parameters.name: sink_arn
